claimWorkflow.title: Claim Review Workflow
claimWorkflow.summary: Structured sample showing how the local insurance flow moves from document intake to a decision with cited evidence.

step.title: Upload policy
step.detail: Accept one PDF policy document and extract searchable text chunks.

step.title: Parse the query
step.detail: Pull out age, location, condition, policy duration, and claim amount.

step.title: Run rule checks
step.detail: Compare the parsed claim against waiting periods, exclusions, and age limits.

step.title: Return the answer
step.detail: Respond with ACCEPT or REJECT, likely payout, and source evidence.
